nalli:10347766645035.description: Kolam is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram saree handwoven with half-fine gold zari, inspired by the artistry of South Indian Kolam. A tone-on-tone jacquard body lends quiet depth, framed by a ghetti border with Kolam forms and zari Rudraksha butas. The pallu unveils the regal Gandaberunda motif amid brocade texture and luminous gold detailing.

nalli:10347766448427.description: Arunima is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram handwoven with half-fine gold zari, distinguished by its Mubaggam three-part composition. Crafted in the rare Korvai four-shuttle weave, contrasting upper and lower panels are framed with cross-leaf Kamalam peths. Floral butas enrich the centre, while the pallu is finished with zari Ghetti bands and Vanki detailing.

nalli:10347763990827.description: Amodhini is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram handwoven with half-fine gold and silver zari. Silver Vanki Pet lines frame a compact Kamalam Pet, enriched with two-tone Meenakari over gold zari. Small Mayil butas bring measured rhythm across the body, while the pallu echoes the border with individually woven peacock motifs. Refined in detail, graceful in presence.

nalli:10347763826987.description: Malar is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram saree handwoven with half-fine gold zari, inspired by the symmetry of temple architecture. The Korwai temple border features a traditional double pet with Kamalam motifs accented in meenakari and silk thread work, finished with Manga Moggu. Monochrome Kasa-Kasa Kattam checks with Kamalam butas and a Yanai floral pallu complete its composed grandeur.

nalli:10347763663147.description: Amudhai is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram saree handwoven with half-fine gold and silver zari. A radiant broad gold tissue border is adorned with Mayilkann pet and Manga moggu detailing, while dual-tone Mayil butas glide across the body. Vintage Paisa motifs in the pleats and an expansive contrasting pallu complete this richly composed heirloom drape.

nalli:10347763499307.description: Ambara is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram saree handwoven with half-fine gold zari, centred on the classic Manga motif. A contrasting silk border is traced with delicate manga detailing, while measured manga butas move across the body with graceful rhythm. The pallu unfolds into an intricate woven jaal, where silk and zari create a subtle interplay of richness and light.

nalli:10347763302699.description: Aathira is a pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram handwoven with half-fine gold zari, shaped by the grace of the cypress motif. A fine border with leaf detailing and Lavangipoo Peth glows softly in gold, while delicate floral butas rest across the silk body. The contrasting pallu features rhythmic cypress patterns enriched with Mayil and Yanai motifs, creating a poised and distinguished drape.

tags: Koadu Kattam and Half & Half - Half Fine/Without Zari

nalli:10322676089131.description:
Dvisha features a rare double pallu using the exceptional double petni technique, demanding 200+ hours of weaving with five shuttles. The first pallu showcases twin peacocks in sacred konia butta, and the second displays an intricate seepu reku design. Korvai borders feature dancing mayils, while kamalam butis adorn the body.
Crafted In: Pure Silk, Pure Gold Zari
Technique: Korvai | Double Petni

nalli:10322675302699.description:
Suvarna is a contemporary take on a traditional design, a pure silk body paired with korvai tissue borders and a tissue petni pallu. The challenging tissue weave uses pure gold zari, creating a translucent shimmer. Korvai borders feature kamalam bel with jamul details. Pallu shows kamalam vine with vanki ghetti motif.
Crafted In: Pure Silk | Pure Gold Zari
Technique: Tissue Korvai | Tissue Petni
